root_cause.text: The URB completion callback resubmits the URB without re-anchoring it to the priv->rx_submitted anchor, so after the USB framework unanchors it before the callback, the URB is no longer tracked and leaks when the driver cleanup calls usb_kill_anchored_urbs().
